text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Saddam Hussein chairs cabinet meeting
- More world countries welcome Iraq's oil-for-food deal with U.N.
- Egyptian minister says Netanyahu is ignorant about history of the region
- Minister of culture and information meets Algerian delegation
- France to exploit huge oilfield in Angola
(The above were also carried by QADISSIYA and JUMHOURIYA)
- Iraq and Jordan discuss flow of goods under the oil deal
- Billions of forged dollars in use in the Middle East
- Clinton starts his second term with deep diferences with Europe
- U.S. and Europe turn position of the U.N. Secretary- General into a deal
- China rejects opening its markets to foreign goods
